items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You've seen that sign, haven't you, Crawford? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Tell me your name. My name is Crawford Lawson Crawford.

ctx.x: You've seen that sign, haven't you, Crawford? Which one is that? Put your name on there while you're at it.
Tell me your name. My name is Crawford Lawson Crawford.
Oh good, we gotta have everybody's name down.
